bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for product price text
affected_users: older adults with declining contrast sensitivity
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the price text (e.g., $89.99) in each product card
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Price text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (or 3:1 if it qualifies as large text).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Price text uses #aaaaaa on a #ffffff background, resulting in a contrast ratio of 2.32:1, which fails the minimum requirement.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for .product-card:nth-child(1) > p, change color from #aaaaaa to #747474 (4.67:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.32:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Missing alternative text on product images
steps_to_reproduce: Observe that the element has no alt attribute
Observe that the element also has no alt attribute
bugLogs.expected_behavior: All informative images must have a descriptive alt attribute (or be marked as decorative with alt="" or role="presentation").
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Both and lack alt attributes, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, and role overrides.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add meaningful alt text to each image, e.g., and . If the images are purely decorative, use alt="" or role="presentation".
